headline: OnlyFants Drops a 174 and the League Drops Its Pants
subhead: Week 4 served up a 1-point heart attack, a 33-point execution, and Nut Olave leaving an entire RB2 on the bench while still winning.
matchOfTheWeek: Nut Olave Your Face squeaked past Little Peckers by 1.22 in a game that had no business being that close — Mustard went for 28.1, but Carson Wentz (23.2) and Marvin Mims (20.5) were rotting on the bench while George Pickens (33.4), Omarion Hampton (27.5), and Mahomes (27.3) all went nuclear for Pecks. Nick literally left 37.42 points on the pine and still won. That's not a victory, that's a felony.
mainRecap:
OnlyFants hung 174.62 on Browning Out in a shootout where Puka Nacua's 36-burger STILL wasn't enough — Patrick scored 168.48 and got handed an L because Ashton Jeanty (33.5) decided this was the week to remember he's a first-rounder. Two top-tier rosters trading haymakers and somehow Cubby's the one walking out with the belt and a 174 spot.

T Swift's Baddies absolutely curb-stomped QAmon 171.78 to 137.88, and the cherry on top? Kyle had Woody Marks (27.9) glued to his bench while Tiny-Handed Vampire and the rest of the QAmon roster wheezed to a 33-point loss. Start your guys, dawg. Dead Rat energy all over this lineup.

Christian McCalfinjury smoked Rub My Chubb by 25 behind Dak's 30.96, which is hilarious because Big D actually ran the most efficient lineup in the league at 97.1% — he just didn't have the horses. Kenneth Gainwell putting up 31.4 for your team is the fantasy equivalent of finding a $20 bill in pants you're about to throw away. Congrats and condolences.

Stroud Boys took down McBridesStrangeWhiteHock despite Josh Jacobs going for 31.7, because Rocks's roster outside Jacobs looked like a Week 17 tank job. Egbukkake edged The Good Ladds by 6, but Szara left Romeo Doubs and his 29.8 on the bench — you're welcome that The Mascot and Perc Hurts bailed you out, because that lineup decision was straight criminal. Meanwhile Mig's collection of Jaydens 1, 2, and 3 couldn't outscore a guy starting Erick None and Insta Drop. Read that back.

powerRankings.blurb: Just dropped 174 with Jeanty going full supernova — the scariest team in the league and Cubby knows it.
Puka went for 36 and you still lost, which is somehow both heartbreaking and proof your roster is filthy.

Dak's 30-burger covered for Jaxson Dart sitting on 19.84 of bench points; Wunder's still cruising.
Won by 1.22 while leaving 37 points on the bench — the most undeserving 'W' since participation trophies.
Pickens, Hampton, AND Mahomes all went off and Big Papi still lost by a point — the football gods spit in his face.
Quietly 2-2 vibes, beat the right opponent this week, and Money Mill$ is somehow still rostered.
Won the game and lost the lineup-construction battle by leaving Doubs and his 29.8 on the bench like a coward.
